text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 46, July 07, 1936 ]
DESIGNATION OF OFFICERS AND EMPLOYEES WHO MAY BE GRANTED DEFERMENT OF
THEIR TRAINEE INSTRUCTION FOR A PERIOD NOT TO EXCEED THREE YEARS
Upon the recommendation of the Chief of Staff, Army of the Philippines, and pursuant to the provisions of
section sixty-four (a) of Commonwealth Act Numbered One, I hereby designate the following officers and
employees who may be granted deferment of their trainee instruction for not to exceed three years:
Municipal treasurers, school teachers, postmasters, telegraph operators, weather observers, and such other
officers and employees of the Insular, provincial, municipal, and municipal district governments who may
present certificates from their respective bureau chiefs to the acceptance boards to the effect that they cannot
be relieved without detriment to the service.
Done at the City of Manila, this seventh day of July, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and thirty-six,
and of the Commonwealth of the Philippines, the first.
MANUEL L. QUEZON
President of the Philippines
By the President:
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
Secretary of the Interior
